categories.main_business_segments: Kunming Chuan Jin Nuo Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the chemical manufacturing industry focusing on wet-process phosphoric acid production. Its main business segments include production and sales of feed-grade phosphate additives, fertilizers (notably heavy and rich calcium phosphate), purified phosphoric acid for industrial and food use, and new energy materials such as lithium iron phosphate battery materials. The company also engages in research and development related to phosphoric acid purification and phosphate salt products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes wet-process phosphoric acid technology, including semi-water and dihydrate methods, combined with proprietary flotation techniques to upgrade low to medium-grade phosphate ores. It has developed advanced extraction and purification technologies for wet-process phosphoric acid, enabling production of food-grade purified phosphoric acid. The company also integrates sulfuric acid production from pyrite and comprehensive utilization of phosphogypsum by-products, emphasizing energy efficiency and environmental protection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large domestic feed producers, agricultural enterprises, and international fertilizer distributors. The company serves the agriculture sector with phosphate fertilizers and feed additives, the food and pharmaceutical industries with purified phosphoric acid, and the new energy sector with lithium iron phosphate materials for batteries. Its export markets cover South America, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East, with a strong presence in global heavy calcium phosphate fertilizer markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in China, with major production bases in Kunming (Yunnan Province) and Guangxi (Fangchenggang). The company has established subsidiaries and production facilities in these regions and a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong for international trade. Its sales network extends domestically across multiple Chinese regions and internationally to global markets, particularly in South America, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kunming Chuan Jin Nuo Chemical operates primarily in the midstream segment of the phosphate chemical supply chain, processing phosphate ores into phosphoric acid and phosphate salts. It sources raw phosphate minerals and sulfuric acid, processes them into intermediate and finished chemical products, and supplies downstream industries such as agriculture, feed, food, pharmaceuticals, and new energy materials manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation in phosphoric acid purification, phosphate ore flotation, and resource recycling technologies. It is advancing R&D in high-purity phosphoric acid, feed-grade phosphate additives, and lithium iron phosphate battery materials. Strategic priorities include expanding the new energy materials segment, optimizing raw material utilization, and enhancing environmental sustainability through waste recycling and emission reduction technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical products including feed-grade phosphate additives, fertilizers, purified phosphoric acid, and new energy materials. Sales are conducted via a combination of direct sales to large customers and distribution through authorized dealers domestically and internationally. The company also earns government subsidies and engages in cash management activities for financial income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading wet-process phosphoric acid producer in China, with technology and product quality comparable to industry leaders. Domestic competitors include Yunnan Xiangfeng, Sanhuan Zhonghua, Guizhou Phosphate Chemical, and Hubei Xiangyun. The company holds a strong market position in feed-grade phosphate salts and heavy calcium phosphate fertilizers, with recognized brand reputation domestically and internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.21 billion, an 18.3% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 176 million, a significant turnaround from prior losses. Total assets reached RMB 3.61 billion with a stable asset-liability ratio of 28.11%. The company demonstrated strong cash flow growth and increased R&D investment by 37.5%, reflecting a positive growth trajectory and expanding scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary wet-process phosphoric acid purification technology enabling food-grade products, flexible production lines allowing rapid product mix adjustments, and comprehensive resource utilization including phosphogypsum recycling. Its products offer high purity, environmental compliance, and cost advantages. The integration of phosphate chemical production with new energy material development provides a unique competitive edge in cost control and product innovation.
